morire.consejo: Intransitive verb with remote passage die.

governare.consejo: Regular transient verb of the first conjugation.

bloques.titulo: Use in literary and historical narration
texto: In front of the prossimo passage, which connects the fact concluded with the current speaker, the remote passage places the event in a chronological dimension that is definitely closed or consecrated by history: «Dante nacque nel 1265 e morì a Ravenna nel 1321».

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: morphology of the regular remote passage
The history of the antic border

frases.it: Chi governò questo territorio nel Medioevo?
frases.es: ¿Quién gobernó este territorio en la Edad Media?
frases.en: Who ruled this territory in the Middle Ages?

frases.it: I duchi di Urbino governarono la regione con grande fermezza per due secoli.
frases.es: Los duques de Urbino gobernaron la región con gran firmeza durante dos siglos.
frases.en: The dukes of Urbino ruled the region with great firmness for two centuries.

frases.it: E quando fondarono la prima università cittadina?
frases.es: ¿Y cuándo fundaron la primera universidad de la ciudad?
frases.en: And when did you start the first university in the city?

frases.it: La fondarono nel quindicesimo secolo, e il duca morì pochi anni dopo.
frases.es: La fundaron en el siglo quince, y el duque murió pocos años después.
frases.en: They founded it in the 15th century, and the Duke died a few years later.

bloques.pregunta: What is the regular completion of third person plural in -are for the remote passage?

opciones.explicacion: It is the regular deinence of the verbs in -ere.
It is the termination corresponding to the verbs in -ire.

bloques.frase: Nel quindicesimo secolo gli studiosi ___ la celebre biblioteca del palazzo.

opciones.explicacion: This is an indication that is incompatible with the medieval historical narrative.
Simple future time that does not describe facts concluded.

bloques.frase: Il celebre scultore morì a Roma nel milleseicento.

opciones.texto: The insignia artist died in Rome in 1600.
opciones.explicacion: Remote past completed in the historical biography.

opciones.texto: The sculptor currently resides in a workshop in the capital.
opciones.explicacion: This is a wrong presence that contradicts the biographical fact.

opciones.texto: The artist will travel next year to Rome to inaugurate his work.
opciones.explicacion: It places the event in future action.

bloques.pregunta: What regular form corresponds to the third person singular of «ricevere» in remote passage?

opciones.explicacion: Both forms coexist with full validity in the verbs in -ere.
Descriptive imperfect that does not express completed action.
Next analytical past that does not follow the pattern of the remote passage.

bloques.frase: Il sovrano illuminato ___ con saggezza durante tutto il suo lungo regno.

opciones.explicacion: Third person singular from remote past in -are.
This is an inappropriate indication in historical accounts.
It would express a continuous state without focusing the historical conclusion.

bloques.frase: I duchi governarono per due secoli
bloques.traduccion: The dukes ruled for two centuries
bloques.explicacion: Order the elements in remote passage.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct form of «ellos terminaron» in regular remote past?

opciones.explicacion: Regular deinence - irono for the third conjugation (-ire).

intro: The remote passage has very systematic regular endings in the three conjugations: -are (-ai, -asti, -ò, -ammo, -aste, -arono), -ere (-ei / -etti, -esti, -é / -ette, -emmo, -this, -erono / -ettero) and -ire (-ii, -isti, -ì, -immo, -iste, -irono). Dominating these disinences makes it possible to follow without difficulty biographies and literary works.
